data.name: Fatihatun
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'fathah', meaning 'opener' or 'opener of the heart'. In Islamic tradition, it is used to refer to the first chapter (surah) of the Quran.

in_pashto.name: فاتحاتون

in_english.name: Fatihatun
